venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Friday 7/3 (MOD: MKZ/JK).** Net sales $2,830 against a $6,484 target (−56%), 91 guests at a $31.10 check average; comps light at $19.80. Weather 92/76. Holiday-eve vibes were high with a nice flow of guests at open, but a mid-shift lull never truly picked back up before the July 4 weekend. Team focused on table touches, activations and DJ promotion; food sales $497 (great day for tickets per kitchen). Favorite moment: the late pop of bartenders at EON — 'we can always depend on our community.' No incidents, no 86s.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Friday 7/3 (MOD: KK/KE/MD & Chef JMS).** Net sales $7,727 vs a $10,299 target (−25%), ~281 guests at a $27.50 check average; comps $236.30 / 3.0% (mostly tech issues). Peculiar Friday: slow start, built from 7pm–10pm, then a noticeable drop-off around 11pm — many folks were out earlier before thunderstorms settled in and stayed home to gear up for the holiday weekend. Fun shift with a full crew; food sales low for a Friday at $258 ('guests just weren't in a food mood'). Maintenance: Well 3 Chiller. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Friday 7/3 (AM: Carey+Evan; PM: Maggie S+Walcott+Evan).** Total net sales $20,170 vs a $15,775 target (+28%), 364 guests (Tock); comps $411 (mostly gifts). Splits: DC/AM $1,378.69, D&C PM $18,792.09, Garden/6A $4,725.25; food $3,235; net event sales $1,459. Solid Friday in the cafe with good cocktail vibes; a 'super dead' D&C night with openers cut by 9:30pm and a chill finish, going on a brief wait at 10:45pm. Event: Ramble closing resident-artist reception for McKenzie Parrott, 60–70 guests 5–8pm in Vauxhall with a live band. Fireworks and great vibes to close out — Happy 4th.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Friday 7/3 (MOD: Gigi/Julian & Chef Saleh/Josh).** Net sales $11,907 vs a $12,459 target (−4%), 329 guests at an $87.80 check average; comps $433.90. Splits: Standing Room $3,101 (food $452), Marquee $8,750 (food $1,608); total food $2,082. Mellow start with time for admin, filling up around 8:30–9pm and staying busy to close with a strong multi-hour waitlist — most large 7–8-tops couldn't be seated and were texted apologies. Jesse Sherman (former FOHM) in for dinner; Julian trained MOD. Kitchen got R&D done; oven still down (knob). One incident reported. 86: cookies, pot de creme, cruise control.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DCDC — Friday 7/3 (MOD: Marcus/Josh/Jesse).** Net sales $6,191.84 vs a $9,566 target (−35%), 170 guests (63 resos / 107 walk-ins) at a $34.59 average; comps $306.11 / 4.9% (family-meal glizzys, employee discount, DNLs). Wicked-hot night hit foot traffic — several cancellations and no-shows kept the room from staying full, but the space was seated fully twice before settling into a trickle. Garden too hot to open. Chef Josh rocked the Glizzy bar. Easy natural last call at 1:15am, empty by 1:40am. Favorite moment: sending guests off with popsicles. Maintenance: broken carb-hose hooks, ice machine pooling, curtains off rails.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Friday 7/3 (AM: Sam/Justin/Shannon; PM: Braden/Marcus).** Total net sales $10,067 vs a $12,000 target (−16%); food $3,150; comps $374. Splits: Municipal Bar morning $1,573 (13 guests) / evening $8,663 (142 guests), Sun Club $1,114, Hot Eye $1,431. Slow, hot Friday morning resting up before the big weekend; slower evening with no full turns but a nice 9:45pm pop that carried to close. A guest fainted from standing up too fast/heat (only 1 cocktail + 2 wines over 3.5 hrs) — Sierra and Eryn responded swiftly with ice and ginger ale. Hot Eye celebrated Alexis's 30th birthday with a generous crowd. Maintenance: booth 44 badly ripped; chicken breast low pending truck.
